items.html: For you already know that the throat is the secret of their skull. Now, if you look at a man when he bends his head, then the throat is covered and included in the end of the cheeks of the head; but when he straightens his head, then the throat is seen. And when the upper coupling of the mouth of AA is made in the secret of kisses, then it descends below, from the end of the mouth, in the secret of the bending of the head, and then the throat is literally included in them, and it is the secret of the head of AVI, and it descends until the NHY of AVI, which are included in the head of ZA.
